title: unknown fields the near miss must stay silent about
notes: The negative half of E-SCHEMA-002: three unknown fields, none of which may be corrected. The fourth line the golden used to carry -- `array should be: text`, a claim against the `as: array` the user had right -- is gone: `JoinType` is now selected by its `as:` const, as blocks are by their kind, so `wth` is checked against `JoinArray` and nothing false is said about `as:`.
